summary: Fleet failure isolation — automated scenario tests 1-7 over the forward components (fleet controller, leases, scheduler, knowledge fallback/sync, network registry)
tests: tests/unit/tenx-phase-10p.test.ts (7 tests): Scenario 1 node A offline → B/C leases untouched; Scenario 2 provider A unavailable → unrelated p2 task routes to node-y and runs; Scenario 3 global KB offline → local fallback contribution recorded (main work unblocked); Scenario 4 proxy node failure → direct node route stays DIRECT; Scenario 5 controller restart → durable members+leases+checkpoint restored; Scenario 6 node dropout mid-task → checkpoint takeover to B resumes from cp-9; Scenario 7 composite faults (A offline + provider failed + KB offline + proxy C failed) → B still completes unrelated task and KB still accepts local fallback
notes: All faults are injected deterministically; no live provider/network needed. Directly proves FLEET-CONTRACT §4 scenarios 1-7.
